1879060952.Skill_Desc: Daze the enemy briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

1879064152.Skill_Desc: You put yourself in harm's way to defend your nearby companions, taking half of all damage dealt to them upon yourself.

1879073752.Skill_Desc:
You rip at your target's flesh, tearing muscle and slowing his attacks. If the target was suffering from your crippling bite he begins taking damage over time. <rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer: Brutal Fangs 
 Reduces Evade rating. 
 Brute bonus: Reduces armour rating. 
 
 In Shadow: Shadow Fangs 
 Increases induction time and reduces parry rating.   </rgb>

1879218264.Skill_Desc:
Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

Has a chance to generate additional Focus.

Arrows inflict Light damage.

1879230296.Skill_Desc:
As a shadow, your swift movements conceal the bestial nature of your claws.
Bonus critical chance.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879243992.Skill_Desc: You issue a fearsome call to arms that negatively affects enemies surrounding you while bolstering allies around you.

1879244376.Skill_Desc: You fire an explosive tipped arrow at your target that will detonate shortly after impact.

1879302616.Skill_Desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879315032.Skill_Desc: Seeing a weakness in the enemy's defences, you exploit it, increasing your target's vulnerability to damage.\n\nMakes targets more vulnerable to Tactical damage in Man form.

1879316056.Skill_Desc: Catch your breath and recuperate. Restores Morale and places a heal over time on the Beorning.

1879334744.Skill_Desc: These arrows will make servants of the Eye burn, fearing as they do the goodness of the Dúnedain.

1879339352.Skill_Desc: Brings out a leaf-fall kite for you to fly!
1879339352.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Fall Festival.

1879360856.Skill_Desc: Brings out a banded snake to keep you company.

Strike your foe with preternatural force.

This skill consumes all your Mettle, but deals 15% bonus damage for each point of Mettle it consumes.
This bonus damage stacks with Battle Flow.

1879468376.Skill_Desc: Let out a battle cry, causing you to rapidly gain Wrath.

1879488728.Skill_Desc: Beseech a wild Bog-lurker to aid you.
